name: agent-hub
description: A Claude-Code-web-style control center for Kimi Code on all your computers: follow and drive Kimi (terminal or kimi web) from one browser UI.

scripts.check: for f in server/*.js server/adapters/*.js public/js/*.js bridge/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.build:daemon: esbuild server/claude-daemon.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=bridge/claude-daemon.mjs "--banner:js=/* Generated from server/claude-daemon.js by npm run build:daemon (do not edit). */ import { createRequire as __agentHubCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __agentHubCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
